notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Atsushi to die.
description:
Kill Atsushi.
Atsushi triggers, creating three Food tokens, three Clue tokens and three Treasure tokens.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token and causing all tokens you control to become Treasure tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Revel in Riches triggers, causing you to win the game.
